relation: Finite supplied-family incidence regularity: hg_regular E d holds when every vertex v of the finite carrier lies in exactly d members of the supplied family E : {set {set T}}, counted by A10 incidence_degree E v. Arbitrary carrier and family, E before d, universal equality; no uniformity, positivity, inhabited-carrier, nonempty-edge, covering or attained-degree premise (an empty carrier is regular of every degree; empty members never count). Simple-graph, multigraph, directed and infinite (ordinal neighbour enumeration, D4inf3) regularity are separate.
summary: D8 turns X73 x73_regular into the alias of the new public Hypergraph.foundations.hypergraph_regularity.hg_regular E d: every vertex lies in exactly d members of the supplied family, counted by A10 incidence_degree; same finite carrier, E before d, universal equality, all empty cases kept. Infinite.conjectures.D4inf3.regular is a deferred distinct class of the same owner.

Frozen at the D7 pin in hypergraph-theory/theories/migration/regularity.v: the source (keeping the live A10 degree alias) and the complete current X73 row over it (keeping the live D2 partite and D6 matching aliases): 1 current whole iff. The complete Original is the existing, unchanged D6 X73MatchingOriginal row with its genuine D6 iff, reused as an original-statement; it and the four providers it reaches (A10 raw degree and regularity, D2 raw partite source, D6 raw matching) are borrowed with explicit effective commits. 2 owned + 5 borrowed mappings; 2 whole iff.

No older proof needed adaptation. The old D2 X73PartiteLegacy and D6 X73MatchingLegacy current rows, which still call the live x73_regular, stay byte-exact with notes; the other four old frozen X73 declarations (A10 helper and row, D2 and D6 Originals) are untouched. Public client hypergraph-theory/theories/examples/regular_hypergraphs.v.

D9 (superseding the deferral recorded above) migrates the infinite-neighbour-enumeration class of this owner: Infinite.conjectures.D4inf3.regular is now the alias of the public Infinite.foundations.regularity.iregular r G on the existing iGraph carrier (local injective I_r enumeration of exactly the neighbours, no choice). Frozen in infinite-graph-theory/theories/migration/regularity.v, bound at this family baseline 7e030f2 (frozen at the D8 pin 216204c, descriptive; source and closure byte-identical at both): the source and the complete existential row with both outer existentials and all five conjuncts (2 < r, locally_finite, regular, one_ended, the spanning-double-ray uniquely_hamiltonian proxy). 2 owned mappings, 1 whole iff; with the finite class 9 mappings and 3 whole iff. No older proof adapted; the five reverse files (21 old headers) are unchanged. The short name regular is also GTBase.base.regular and other local constants: the cross-module consumers and frozen bodies that the repository-wide lexical scan reaches outside the actual D4inf3 reverse closure are declared as lexical matches only.
kernel_evidence: Exact types/implicit status of the source and its Section-discharged canonical, the two whole iff, all old declarations against 7e030f2, the actual eight-file reverse closure (132 headers), Print Assumptions and Locate/About-resolved strict closures, through the pinned image. /srv/graph-theory-rocq/coordination/evidence/D8-by-lancelot/ (outside the repository); D9 (infinite class): exact types, record identity, Print Assumptions, Locate/About-resolved closures, meaningful negatives and the 21 reverse headers under /srv/graph-theory-rocq/coordination/evidence/D9-by-lancelot/
